name.en: Sour egg sauce for beans and potatoes
name.de: Saure Eiersauce zu Bohnen und Kartoffeln

originalName: Sour Egg Sauce for Salad Beans, also for Potatoes

source.author: Henriette Davidis
source.title: A Practical Book of the Art of Cooking as Performed in Germany (Milwaukee, Wis.: C. N. Caspar Co., Book Emporium)
source.place: Division R, No. 47, printed page 360; lines 26864-26872 of the text file

cupful.read: The source is an American edition (title page: "Compiled and adapted for the United States, according to the Thirty-fifth German Original, with Weights and Measures in American equivalents"); taken as the US customary cup of units.json (236.5882365 ml). A judgement.

teaspoonful.read: The source is an American edition (title page: "Compiled and adapted for the United States, according to the Thirty-fifth German Original, with Weights and Measures in American equivalents"); taken as the US customary teaspoon of units.json (4.92892159375 ml). A judgement.

note.en: As much as gives the sauce the sourness wanted.
note.de: So viel, dass die Sauce die gewünschte Säure bekommt.

sourceNote.en: The source gives no amount: "enough vinegar to give the sauce the required acidity".
sourceNote.de: Die Quelle nennt keine Menge: "enough vinegar to give the sauce the required acidity".

sourceNote.en: The text file prints "teaspoonfur"; the printed page reads "1 teaspoonful of flour".
sourceNote.de: Die Textdatei druckt "teaspoonfur"; auf der gedruckten Seite steht "1 teaspoonful of flour" (1 Teelöffel Mehl).

note.en: Two pieces: one cooked in the sauce, one stirred in at the end.
note.de: Zwei Stücke: eines wird mitgekocht, eines am Ende eingerührt.

sourceNote.en: The source says "a piece of butter" and "another piece of butter" and gives no amount. The German Milwaukee edition (36th German edition, Division R, No. 50) gives a size: as its machine-read text has it, a good half egg of butter, and as much again at the end.
sourceNote.de: Die Quelle sagt "a piece of butter" und "another piece of butter" und nennt keine Menge. Die deutsche Milwaukee-Ausgabe (36. deutsche Auflage, Abschnitt R, Nr. 50) nennt eine Größe: nach ihrem maschinell gelesenen Text reichlich ein halbes Ei dick Butter und am Ende noch einmal so viel.

note.en: Very little, and only if the butter is hardly salted.
note.de: Sehr wenig, und nur wenn die Butter kaum gesalzen ist.

text.en: Mix the cold water with vinegar until it is as sour as the sauce is wanted.
text.de: Das kalte Wasser mit Essig mischen, bis es so sauer ist, wie die Sauce werden soll.

text.en: Stir in the yolks, the flour, a piece of the butter and the nutmeg; add a very little salt if the butter is hardly salted.
text.de: Eigelb, Mehl, ein Stück der Butter und Muskat einrühren; ist die Butter kaum gesalzen, ganz wenig Salz zugeben.

text.en: Beat the sauce with a whisk without stopping until it is just short of boiling.
text.de: Die Sauce ohne Unterbrechung mit dem Schneebesen schlagen, bis sie kurz vor dem Kochen steht.

text.en: Off the heat, go on stirring for a few minutes; this keeps the sauce from curdling.
text.de: Vom Feuer nehmen und noch einige Minuten weiterrühren; so gerinnt die Sauce nicht.

text.en: Stir in the second piece of butter.

settled.reason: Our judgement: the source names no number of persons. The neighbouring Asparagus Sauce No. 1 (Division R, No. 44) gives 1 cupful of liquid and 2 yolks for 4 persons; this sauce has 1 cupful of water and 3 yolks.

check.note: Second agent session, 2026-11-23, not the transcriber. Numbers read on the page image (archive.org scan PDF, p. 360). Print agrees: 1 cupful cold water, yolks of 3 eggs, 1 teaspoonful flour (clear in print; "teaspoonfur" is the text file); vinegar, butter, nutmeg, salt without amount; no persons. German Milwaukee ed. (henriettedavidis01davi, OCR): 3 yolks, 1 Theeloeffel agree; butter a good half egg, twice (sourceNote, not entered). Changed: step off the heat reworded.

note.en: The source serves the sauce with salad beans and with potatoes. Vinegar and butter have no amount in the source.
note.de: Die Quelle gibt die Sauce zu Salatbohnen und zu Kartoffeln. Essig und Butter haben in der Quelle keine Menge.
